```{r}
library(ggdendro)

lym = read.csv("./data/lymphoma_labelled.txt", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
X <- t(lym)
labels = case_when(grepl("DLCL", colnames(lym)) ~ 1,
                   grepl("FL", colnames(lym)) ~ 2,
                   grepl("CLL", colnames(lym)) ~ 3)

gene_names = read.csv("./data/figure1.cdt.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
```

```{r}
bcbc_obj <- readRDS("/cwork/sgr26/BCBC_ADAPTIVE_lymphoma_labelled_42459834.RDS")
```

```{r}

best_lambdas <- bcbc_obj$lambda_cv$cv_data |>
  filter(is.finite(eBIC)) |>
  arrange(eBIC2) |>
  head()

best_lambda_index <- best_lambdas[1, "param_index"]
fit <- bcbc_obj$lambda_cv$all_runs[[best_lambda_index]]


plot(sort(fit$w))
plot_fit(bcbc_result_to_df(fit, filter_weight = 0, labels = labels))
plot_fit(bcbc_result_to_df(fit, filter_weight = 0, labels = labels), bin_scale = 20)
plot_fit(bcbc_result_to_df(fit, filter_weight = 1 / 4026, labels = labels))
```

```{r}
col_clusters_w_weights <- tibble(
    weight = fit$w,
    cluster = bcbc_obj$lambda_cv$col_clusters[[best_lambdas[1, "index"]]],
    name = gene_names$NAME,
    num_missing = apply(X, 2, function(w) { sum(is.na(w))}),
    weight_rank = rank(-weight),
    missing_rank = rank(-num_missing, ties.method = "min"),
  ) |>
  mutate(index = row_number())

col_clusters_w_weights |> filter(weight_rank < 100, missing_rank < 100)

cluster_info = col_clusters_w_weights |> group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_weight = mean(weight),
    mean_weight_norm = mean(weight) * 4026,
    sum_weight = sum(weight),
    max_weight = max(weight),
    max_weight_norm = max(weight) * 4026,
    highest_gene = index[which.max(weight)],
    highest_gene_name = name[which.max(weight)]
  ) |>
  arrange(-mean_weight) |>
  mutate(mean_weight_rank = row_number())

```

```{r}

method = "single"
plot_df <- bcbc_result_to_df(fit, labels = labels, cluster_with_weights = F, method = method)
plot_df <- plot_df |>
  inner_join(col_clusters_w_weights |> dplyr::select(-weight), by = c("col_num" = "index")) |>
  inner_join(cluster_info |> dplyr::select(cluster, mean_weight_rank, n), by = "cluster")

fill_attr = "value"
bin_scale = 100

num_top_clusters = 8
cluster_labels = strsplit(substr("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ", 1, num_top_clusters), "")[[1]]

col_hclust <- hclust(dist(t(fit$U)), method = method)
col_hclust_data <- dendro_data(col_hclust, type = "rectangle")

label_annotation <- annotate(
  geom = "rect",
  xmin = -max(plot_df$order_col) / 25,
  xmax = 0,
  ymin = plot_df$order_row - 0.5,
  ymax = plot_df$order_row + 0.5,
  fill = case_when(
    plot_df$label == 1 ~ "#11DDDD",
    plot_df$label == 2 ~ "green",
    plot_df$label == 3 ~ "yellow"
  )
)

raster <- geom_raster(aes(fill = .data[[fill_attr]]))

if (!bin_scale) {
  plot_scale = scale_fill_gradient2()
} else {
  plot_scale = scale_fill_steps2(n.breaks = bin_scale)
}

bicluster_rects <- plot_df |>
  filter(mean_weight_rank <= num_top_clusters) |>
  group_by(cluster, mean_weight_rank) |>
  summarise(cluster_left = min(order_col), cluster_right = max(order_col), n = first(n)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(mean_weight_rank) |>
  mutate(label = cluster_labels,
         midpoint = (cluster_left + cluster_right) / 2)

# Check rectangles are continuous
bicluster_rects$cluster_right - bicluster_rects$cluster_left - bicluster_rects$n

bicluster_annotation = annotate(
  "rect",
  xmin = bicluster_rects$cluster_left,
  xmax = bicluster_rects$cluster_right,
  ymin = 0.5,
  ymax = 62.5,
  fill = NA,
  color = "black",
  linewidth = 0.5,
  linetype = "twodash"
)

text_annotation = annotate(
  "text",
  x = bicluster_rects$midpoint,
  y = -5,
  label = bicluster_rects$label,
  color = "black"
)

y_start = max(plot_df$order_row) + 1
```


```{r}
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = order_col, y = order_row)) +
  raster +
  label_annotation +
  plot_scale +
  geom_segment(data = segment(col_hclust_data), 
               aes(x = x, y = y_start + y / max(y) * 20, xend = xend, yend = y_start + yend / max(yend) * 20)
  ) +
  bicluster_annotation +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = bicluster_rects$midpoint,
                     labels = bicluster_rects$label) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 10, face = "bold",
                               margin = margin(t = 1), family = "Times"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size=20)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim=c(4, 84)) +
  guides(fill = "none") +
  xlab("mRNA Sample") +
  ylab("cDNA Clone") +
  ggtitle("Lymphoma Biclustering")

ggsave("~/BCBC/real_data_experiments/lymphoma.pdf",
       units = "in",
       width = 8,
       height = 4,
       device = "pdf",
       dpi = 900)
```

```{r}
table1 <- cluster_info |>
  arrange(-mean_weight) |>
  head(num_top_clusters) |>
  mutate(Label = cluster_labels,
         mean_weight_norm = round(mean_weight_norm, 2),
         max_weight_norm = round(max_weight_norm, 2)) |>
  rename(Size = n,
         `Mean Weight` = mean_weight_norm, 
         `Max Weight` = max_weight_norm,
         `Highest Weight mRNA Sample` = highest_gene_name) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Label,
    Size,
    `Mean Weight`,
    `Max Weight`,
    `Highest Weight mRNA Sample`
  )

# As LaTeX table
cat(apply(table1, 1, function(r) paste(r, collapse = " & ")), sep = " \\\\\n")

```
